high_level_description: This image is a tweet from the official Twitter account of The Nobel Prize (@NobelPrize). It announces the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded to John J. Hopfield and Geoffrey E. Hinton "for foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks." The tweet includes a graphic illustration of the two laureates, John J. Hopfield on the left and Geoffrey E. Hinton on the right. Both illustrations are in black and white with gold accents, giving them a formal and prestigious appearance.
